From f91b2ab0e0c5f7cb4b11012748a184b91a396f0f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Shaokun Zhang <zhangshaokun@hisilicon.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Aug 2019 17:31:08 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] i2c: designware: Fix unused variable warning
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

drivers/i2c/busses/i2c-designware-master.c: In function ‘i2c_dw_init_recovery_info’:
drivers/i2c/busses/i2c-designware-master.c:658:6: warning: unused variable ‘r’ [-Wunused-variable]
  int r;
      ^
Fixes: 33eb09a02e8d ("i2c: designware: make use of devm_gpiod_get_optional")
Signed-off-by: Shaokun Zhang <zhangshaokun@hisilicon.com>
Acked-by: Jarkko Nikula <jarkko.nikula@linux.intel.com>
Reviewed-by: Andy Shevchenko <andriy.shevchenko@linux.intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Wolfram Sang <wsa@the-dreams.de>

diff --git a/drivers/i2c/busses/i2c-designware-master.c b/drivers/i2c/busses/i2c-designware-master.c
index 867787dade43..e8b328242256 100644
--- a/drivers/i2c/busses/i2c-designware-master.c
+++ b/drivers/i2c/busses/i2c-designware-master.c
@@ -655,7 +655,6 @@ static int i2c_dw_init_recovery_info(struct dw_i2c_dev *dev)
 	struct i2c_bus_recovery_info *rinfo = &dev->rinfo;
 	struct i2c_adapter *adap = &dev->adapter;
 	struct gpio_desc *gpio;
-	int r;
 
 	gpio = devm_gpiod_get_optional(dev->dev, "scl", GPIOD_OUT_HIGH);
 	if (IS_ERR_OR_NULL(gpio))
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/i2c/busses/i2c-designware-master.c`**
   - **Removed Variable**: The unused variable `int r;` was removed from the function `i2c_dw_init_recovery_info`. This change addresses a compiler warning about the variable being declared but not used.

### Relationships

- The modification in `i2c-designware-master.c` is a direct fix for a warning that was likely introduced or highlighted by a previous commit (referenced as `Fixes: 33eb09a02e8d`). The removal of the unused variable improves code quality and maintains compliance with best practices in coding by eliminating unnecessary declarations.
